proposed.long_description:
Knitted cotton handbag with three doll appliqués

Choose a knitted cotton handbag with colorful striped handles and three doll appliqués on the front. Made from 100% cotton, this BHcrafts design combines a knitted bag with detailed handmade decoration. Black and green versions give you two background colors for the doll design.

Colorful details made by hand

The three dolls have knitted outfits, yarn hair, smiling faces, and dangling legs. Flower details and bright stripes add color across the design. The full-view photographs show the bag’s proportions, while the close-ups reveal the doll outfits and knitted texture. The comparison photograph shows the black and green versions together.

Product details

  • Material: 100% cotton.
  • Listed width: 29 cm (11.4 inches).
  • Listed height: 46 cm (18.1 inches).
  • Background colors: Black or Green.
  • Design: Three doll appliqués with colorful striped handles.

Compare these listed measurements with the items you plan to carry.

Carry handmade detail every day

Choose your preferred color for everyday use, or give this handmade cotton bag as a gift. BHcrafts women artisans in Bosnia and Herzegovina bring their craft skills to the knitted fabric and decorative details.

Your purchase includes complimentary gift wrapping in recycled paper and a postcard with customized text. Read more about our Fair Trade mission at www.bhcrafts.org and view the WFTO certificate.

MORE INFORMATION ABOUT ARTISANS
The woman named on the hang tag crafted this product especially for you. Additionally, with every stitch, she infused her knowledge, patience, and love, creating a truly unique and custom-made piece. By choosing this item, you support one of the hundreds of BHcrafts women artisans in earning a living, while enjoying its design and exceptional quality work.
Care for the knitted fabric and doll details according to the product’s care guidance. Ask BHcrafts for any missing instructions before cleaning. Suitable care helps preserve the craftsmanship of your handmade cotton bag.
proposed.short_description: A knitted cotton handbag with three doll appliqués, colorful striped handles, and dangling doll legs. Made from 100% cotton, it is listed at 29 cm wide and 46 cm high. Choose a black or green background for an everyday bag with detailed handmade decoration. Created by BHcrafts women artisans in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
